title: Hardcore Additions
description: Adds configurable revives and other small changes to hardcore difficulty!
body:
# Hardcore Additions

Have you ever had fun playing with friends in a hardcore world, until that _one player_ starts digging straight down until he meets his end? Then this mod may just be for you!

## What is this?
### A mod that adds revives to hardcore worlds.

You will **permanently lose hearts** for every death.\
Hearts can be gaines back by eating an enchanted golden apple.\
You can configure the amount of lost & gained hearts, as well as the option to go over 10 hearts.

**For PvP**, you can disable heart loss or even enable how many hearts can be "stolen".

![3 Hearts remain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/104266e4690c6903f51e5099bcab27e65a52d2c9.png)

## How does it work?
Start a **hardcore** world and change these gamerules:
- **hc-additions:revive_heart_loss**\
_(amount of hearts lost, default: 2)_

- **hc-additions:apple_heart_restore**\
_(amount of hearts gained back, default 1)_


- **hc-additions:allow_bonus_hearts**\
_(can go over 10 hearts, default: false)_


- **hc-additions:pvp_heart_loss**\
_(loose hearts in pvp, default: true)_


- **hc-additions:pvp_heart_steal**\
_(gain hearts through pvp kills, default: 0)_

##
### Footnote
**For multiplayer:** Players without this mod will see "Spectate World" instead of "Revive". This is only a visual change, the behaviour stays the same.

At the moment, this mod works **only for hardcore worlds**. This may change in the future.
